entities.name: Marcello Corvani
entities.description: A veteran military operative who recruits Orion and mentors him at ECAP.
entities.quote: Marcello Corvani — younger, two-eyed, cigar in mouth, wearing a soaked leather jacket and steel-capped boots.

entities.name: Orion
entities.description: A sixteen-year-old boy with sharp instincts who is rescued from a traveling circus.
entities.quote: Inside sits ORION, 16 years old — shirtless, bruised, hair messy, hands chained lightly, not because he’s dangerous... but because the circus wants him to look dangerous.

entities.name: Stitch
entities.description: The leader of ECAP who evaluates the recruitment of Orion.
entities.quote: STITCH: “You brought me a child?” CORVANI: “I brought you a soldier with a brain.”

entities.name: Victor
entities.description: An associate at ECAP who supports Corvani's decision to bring Orion.
entities.quote: Victor smiles: VICTOR: “He saw potential, Stitch. Isn’t that what you used to do?”

entities.name: ECAP
entities.description: A military entity where Corvani, Stitch, and Victor operate.
entities.quote: CUT TO — ECAP HQ, DAYS LATER Stitch watches a report.

entities.name: Circo del Miracolo
entities.description: A traveling circus that exploited Orion for profit.
entities.quote: A worn-out sign reads: “CIRCO DEL MIRACOLO.”

timeline_events.title: Recruitment of Orion
timeline_events.description: Marcello Corvani finds and liberates Orion from the Circo del Miracolo to train him at ECAP.
timeline_events.quote: Corvani removes the chains gently, not forcefully. CORVANI: “If you step out, your life changes.”
